reference.notes: Reference: Rolls-Royce Trent 700 (RR is the engine whose AC nacelle drawing and fanX label match the plan-view nacelle) with the standard (pre-neo) canted A330ceo wingtip device (single kink, about 42 deg from vertical). The A330-200/-300 also fly with GE CF6-80E1 (fanX label 21.14 / 17.94) and PW4000-94 (21.45 / 18.25); their nacelles are larger (not drawn here). A330neo (Trent 7000, sharklets) is a different wing and is NOT represented. nacelleLength 7.32 m is the AC overall length incl. the common nozzle (cowls only about 5.6 m); nacelleDiameter 3.08 m is the AC fan-cowl section width (AC also shows 3.2 m height). Fin is the Post-Mod 48979 fin (height 8.8 m, root chord 8.58 m, tip chord 3.1 m, length 58.82 m); the Pre-Mod 48979 sheet has a taller fin (9.3 m, tip chord 2.79 m, LE offset 9.12 m, overall 59.0 m). Wing is the A333 wing moved 3.2 m forward (plan measurement; same engine-label offset 21.28-18.08). v4: stabiliser fitted to the AC plan labels (A330-200 p.64: tip LE 56.36, TE 58.37, chord 2.01; A330-300 p.61: LE 61.67, TE 63.70, chord 2.03), rootY 2.0. Dorsal fillet measured on the AC side view (the fin dimensions already describe the fin proper): dorsalLength 1.85, dorsalHeight 0.5.

name: Airbus A350-900

reference.notes: Reference: Rolls-Royce Trent XWB (-84 on the -900, -97 on the -1000; the AC gives ONE nacelle drawing for both and the AC plan views show the same nacelle) with the curved blended wingtip (curve starts about 2.8 m inboard of the tip in plan, rises about 2.4 m, end tangent about 25 deg from vertical; AC lists the 2.88 m planform dimension). The black cockpit mask is paint, not nose shape. The AC carries no nacelle dimension drawing, so nacelle diameter/length/y are measured off the AC plan and front views (plan width 3.97 m, front-view circle 4.1 m; 4.0 used). Chevrons: sources conflict whether the Trent XWB nozzle has chevrons (small serrations at most); left null. Fin: AC side-view labels 9.09 (root LE to tip LE x offset), 7.79 (root chord), 3.04 (tip chord), 9.42 (height), tail end at the side-view overall length; fin rootLEx derived as overall side length minus 3.04 minus 9.09. Plan-view x values for the -1000 were shifted +0.24 m to anchor the AC 25.78 m engine label (this reproduces the AC 3.81 m -900/-1000 engine offset). Wing/HTP in 1 g flexed attitude per AC note. A359 overall length 66.80 m (plan); AC side view overall 66.61 m (excludes the tail tip), tail cone end 65.26 m. v3: fuselage.end added from the documented tail-cone end; tailconeLength shortened so the taper still starts at the same station. v4: wingtip.rootY = span/2 - 2.88 (AC plan 2.88 m planform dimension), so the curved device reaches exactly span/2. Stabiliser fitted to the AC anchors: tip chord 2.46, TE at the overall length, rootY 2.0.

name: Airbus A380-800

reference.engine: Rolls-Royce Trent 900 (four; GP7200 shares the AC engine positions, nacelle 3.9 m, 2.52 m reverser; Trent 900 chosen as documented reference)
reference.notes: Reference: Trent 900 on all four positions (inboard y 14.8 m, outboard y 25.7 m, each half of the AC front-view engine spacing 29.6 m / 51.4 m; plan-view measurement agrees: 14.5-14.7 and 25.5-25.8). fanX 22.23 / 29.94 m are the AC plan labels. nacelleDiameter 3.9 m and length 8.06 m (nose cowl 1.30 + fan cowl 2.18 + thrust reverser 2.39 + primary nozzle 2.19; cowls only 5.87 m) from the AC Trent 900 nacelle drawing (3.88 m fan-cowl section, 3.9 m max); front-view circle measures 3.9 m too (plan-view width measured only 3.55 m). Wingtip: vertical fence, about 1.2 m above and 1.1 m below the tip chord line (front-view measurement). Double deck: fuselage 7.14 m wide x 8.41 m high (AC: 8.41 m); window rows measured on the AC side view (bottom of the fuselage at the constant section = 0): main deck row about 3.9 m, upper deck row about 6.7 m (centres of the oval windows). Fin from AC labels: 53.94 root LE, 14.08 LE offset, 12.06 root chord, 4.7 tip chord, 14.59 height. Wing root chord 17.67 m is an AC label (root LE to root TE arrow, verified against the plan raster). Wing/HTP 1 g flexed attitude. Plan overall 72.57 m, side overall 72.73 m, fuselage end 70.4 m. v3: noseLength 13 m confirmed on refs/A388/A388_drawing.png (side roof levels out at ~13 m, plan half-width 0.75 at 3.4 m from the tip matches a 13 m nose). Tail cone: belly rises from ~46.5 m, so tailconeLength is 23.9 m to the 70.4 m fuselage end (26.2 m ran to the 72.73 m overall length).
